As I reviewed your website, I found a few important on-page SEO issues that should be addressed. The homepage has an overlength meta title and description, multiple H1 tags, an improper heading structure, and many images missing ALT attributes. I also noticed that your website currently receives very low organic traffic (around 37 monthly visits) and has a low Authority Score of 8, which indicates there is significant room for improvement.
